ai-cyber-security.name: AI for Cyber Security
ai-cyber-security.description: Learn to apply machine learning, deep learning, anomaly detection, behavioral analytics, and adversarial defense to secure enterprise IT/OT environments, financial systems, and cloud assets.
learningObjectives: Understand foundational AI principles and their intersection with enterprise cybersecurity defense.
Master classification, regression, clustering, and anomaly detection algorithms for security telemetry.
Formulate and implement machine learning models for detecting spam, phishing, and malware threats.
Engineer AI-driven solutions to protect authentication systems, verify user identity, and guard sensitive data assets.
Architect end-to-end fraud prevention engines using ensemble methods, bagging, boosting, and rigorous evaluation metrics.
courseOutcomes: CO1: Analyze heterogeneous cybersecurity datasets and extract security features for machine learning pipelines.
CO2: Deploy classical and modern ML algorithms to detect network intrusions and anomalous behavior.
CO3: Construct NLP and deep learning classifiers for email phishing, domain spoofing, and malicious binaries.
CO4: Implement biometrics, keystroke dynamics, and behavioral authentication mechanisms for access protection.
CO5: Design scalable fraud detection systems and evaluate adversarial robustness against evasion attacks.
